name: DocGenerator: Complex Use Case Flow
modt_content:
system
    name ComplexUC

uc Authenticate
    actor User
    description "Allows a user to log in"
    pre User.IsLoggedIn == false
  
    @start step enterCredentials
    step validate :> @sys
    [Invalid] alt goto @start
    [Locked] alt goto @help

    @help step showSupportContact
    post User.IsLoggedIn == true
